name: URY landscape kiosk menu
describe: Landscape kiosk menu at 1920x1080: header (px-10 py-6, 30px semibold title, "New Order" button), category chips with a w-80 search in a border-b strip, a five-column grid (xl, gap-6) of rounded-2xl cards with h-40 images, and the persistent w-[420px] cart panel at the end.

Use as the main ordering screen of an entrance/counter/food-court kiosk. Body text is 18px (text-lg); the grid scrolls in the app, so the lowest row is clipped. Fixed UI labels are author translations for RTL (the self-order app has no locale file) and NEED NATIVE REVIEW; RTL is a kit extension.
